variants.cc-narrow: display:flex; flex-direction:column; max-width:75rem = 1200px (1200px at 1440, 921.6 at 1024, 351 at 390)
variants.cc-hero: the dark rounded homepage hero shell — background primary, radius 4.5em, height 60vh, min-height 800px, overflow hidden, isolation isolate

spanClasses.formula: flex-basis and max-width = N/12 as a percentage

grid.tinyCollapse: At <=479 every .col becomes flex-basis:100%; max-width:100%; order:1; position:static — everything stacks.

shapeScaffolding..u-aspect-9x16: 56% ratio wrapper used by the /trust-safety video and the /careers image-copy split
shapeScaffolding..u-img-cover: object-fit:CONTAIN despite the name; width/height 100%; position:absolute; inset:0

preflightCorollary: Tailwind preflight is DISABLED, so there is no img{height:auto} reset. Any image sized by CSS width alone needs an explicit height, or its HTML height attribute wins (this is why Playdate.svg renders 291.2x180 from height="180", and why payment.webp renders narrower than its 104px cap from width="96").
